title.description: A short title naming what the visitor has explored this session. Where several distinct subjects were explored, reflect the range rather than picking one.

traits.description: Up to 5 keywords naming traits, habitats, classifications, or eras the visitor seems drawn to (e.g. predator, nocturnal, ocean, mammal, ice age).

summary.description: One sentence describing what the visitor is curious about. Address the visitor as "You".
